# Aura: Looksmaxxing

> AI-powered looksmaxxing platform. Upload a selfie, get a PSL score, personalized hairstyle recommendations, a daily glow-up routine, and a 24/7 AI coach — everything you need to reach your potential.

## Product

- [Aura: Looksmaxxing](https://www.aura-looksmaxxing.com): Marketing site and product overview.
- [Pricing](https://www.aura-looksmaxxing.com/pricing): One plan, $9.99/month or $49.99/year. 100 credits per month, everything included.
- [FAQ](https://www.aura-looksmaxxing.com/faq): Common questions about credits, billing, AI models, and image quality.
- [About](https://www.aura-looksmaxxing.com/about): Mission and what the product does.
- [Privacy](https://www.aura-looksmaxxing.com/privacy): How we handle personal data.
- [Terms](https://www.aura-looksmaxxing.com/terms): Terms of service.

## Features

- AI Face Analysis (1 credit per scan): Upload a selfie, receive a PSL score with a detailed breakdown of facial proportions and harmony.
- Hairstyle Try-On (3 credits): Preview different cuts on your face shape using image generation.
- Glow-Up Plan: A personalized daily routine generated from your scan.
- AI Coach: 24/7 chat that has the context of your scan and goals.

## Pricing

- Aura Monthly: $9.99 / month, includes 100 credits per month.
- Aura Yearly: $49.99 / year, includes 100 credits per month (best value).
- Scans cost 1 credit; hairstyle try-ons cost 3 credits.

## Platform availability

- Web: https://www.aura-looksmaxxing.com
- Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.elias.looksmaxxing
